manifest.name: Move Stock Location
manifest.summary: This module allows to move all stock in a stock location to an other one.

DESCRIPTION.text:
This module allows to move entire location of products from one place to
another and move only selected quantities.

USAGE.text:
- A new menu item Operations \> Move from location... opens a wizard where 2 locations
  can be specified.
- Select origin and destination locations and press "IMMEDIATE TRANSFER" or "PLANNED
  TRANSFER"
- Those lines can be edited. Move quantity can't be more than a max available quantity
- Move doesn't care about the reservations and will move stuff anyway
- If during your operation with the wizard the real quantity will change it will move
  only the available quantity at the button press
- Products will be moved and a form view of picking that did that will show up
- If "PLANNED TRANSFER" is used - the picking won't be validated automatically

If you want to transfer a full quant:

- Go to Inventory \> Products \> Products and click "On hand" smart button or Inventory
  \> Reporting \> Inventory, the quants view will be opened.
- Select the quantities which you want move to another location

If you go to the Inventory Dashboard you can see the button "Move from location" in each
of the picking types (only applicable to internal and outgoing transfers). Press it and
you will be directed to the wizard.

![](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/147538094/281480833-208ea309-0bad-43e7-bd6f-8384520afe00.png)

To enable this option, check "Show Move On Hand Stock" in the Picking Type
configuration.

![](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/147538094/281479487-45fa4bde-36be-4ba1-8d54-8e707b89459e.png)

If you want transfer everything from stock.location

On a draft picking, add a button to fill with moves lines for all products in the source
destination. This allows to create a picking to move all the content of a location. The
Origin Location must have stock. The Destination Location has to be a final location. If
some quants are not available (i.e. reserved) the picking will be in partially available
state and reserved moves won't be listed in the operations. Use barcode interface to
scan a location and create an empty picking. Then use the fill with stock button.

ROADMAP.text:
Change the current implementation (suggested by Denis Roussel from
ACSONE):

- A new parameter on stock picking types : 'Product Change Location'
  (with a little help).
- With this, go to the dashboard, create a picking with that type.
- Add a button on the picking form which is visible with that type that
  fill in the picking as now
- Nice to have: add a magic button on locations that with context
  creates a new picking of that type with the origin location already
  filled in.

Note from Jacques-Etienne Baudoux (BCIM)
- The fill with stock action on stock.picking should not create manually the
  move lines but instead call `action_assign()`. There are many modules hooking
  `action_assign` that are not called due to this.

## GITHUB ISSUES (selected)
### #2653 [19.0][IMP] stock_move_location: restrict immediate transfer (pr, open, 2026)
The "Immediate Transfer" button of the Move from location wizard validates
the picking right away. Some companies want every relocation to go through
a planned transfer instead, so that the picking can be checked before it is
validated.
### Changes
- Add a company setting, "Restrict Immediate Transfer in Move Location
 Wizard", in Inventory > Configuration > Settings (Operations section).
 It is disabled by default, so the current behavior is unchanged.
- When it is enabled, the "Immediate Transfer" button is hidden in the
 wizard, and `action_move_location()` raises a `UserError` if it is called
 without the `planned` context, so the restriction also holds for calls
 that do not come from the button.
### Tests
- With the restriction enabled, an immediate transfer raises a `UserError`,
 while a planned transfer still works.
Assisted-by: Claude Opus 5.5
@qrtl QT7284

### #1281 [14.0] stock_move_location - consignment stock (issue, closed, 2021)
If you use consignment to setup the owner of a product when you receive it you cannot transfer a quant directly to another location using "immediate" transfer
The owner_id is missing somewhere so when you try to move directly a quant that is assigned with a partner (owner_id) the quant is not found and it makes a negative stock

### #1420 [13] stock_move_location: wrong evaluation company_id (issue, closed, 2022)
## Module
stock_move_location
In multicompany enviroment, if default user company is different as selected company, the location selection menu in wizard offers wrong values.
**Affected versions**: 13
In my opinion problem is the evaluation of company_id in wizard/stock_move_location.py, line 15:
`company_id = self.env.context.get("company_id") or self.env.user.company_id.id`
and line 122:
`("company_id", "=", self.env.user.company_id.id),`
I think it should be:
`self.env.company.id`

### #2338 [15.0][FIX] stock_move_location: reserved_quantity unfilled in _prepare_wizard_move_lines (pr, closed, 2025)
In addition to the lack of information in the wizard, this results in detailed delivery note transactions disappearing and not being recreated.
https://github.com/OCA/stock-logistics-warehouse/blob/dd0bfe2c2f13e39e6fc9c9c59b65dd1fe358eb7f/stock_move_location/wizard/stock_move_location.py#L238-L244
TT56320

### #1016 [11.0] stock_move_location : no picking_type_id given on stock.move (issue, closed, 2020)
Version : 11.0
Detailed issue:
− When move products from a location to another location, if the product tracking method is not none but there is no tracking checkboxes on picking_type selected, there is an error message saying that we need to define which lots are moved.
